assets.title: 灵貂对峙与神灯祭阵
assets.prompt:
Create a highly polished vertical 9:16 contemporary Chinese supernatural editorial illustration poster depicting a “Spirit Marten and Divine Lamp” nocturnal mythological encounter.

The entire composition should feel like a modern reinterpretation of Chinese strange-tales, ritual objects and supernatural animal folklore through highly controlled flat geometric illustration.

The image must remain T1 flat 2D graphic design rather than realistic animal painting, anime screenshot, game splash art or 3D rendering.

OVERALL COMPOSITION

Build the image around three dominant masses:

1. a gigantic upright ivory-white spirit marten on viewer-right;
2. a much smaller violet spirit marten at lower-left;
3. a tall branching multi-level divine-lamp apparatus rising behind and between them.

The large white creature occupies the center-right and lower-right.

The smaller purple creature remains at lower-left.

The lamp system forms a tall central vertical network extending from the lower-middle to the upper-middle.

Keep the upper third extremely open and dark.

The image should feel tall, sparse and ceremonial.

Do not fill the upper background with scenery.

The negative space is an essential design element.

BACKGROUND

Use a vertical nocturnal color field.

TOP:
almost black,
blue-black,
very deep midnight navy.

UPPER-MIDDLE:
deep indigo,
dark cobalt.

LOWER-MIDDLE:
muted royal blue.

BOTTOM:
pale blue,
misty cyan,
very light blue-gray.

The transition should be broad and subdued rather than glossy.

Overlay:
fine handmade-paper fibers,
very subtle mottling,
light lithographic grain,
slight pigment irregularity,
restrained screen-print texture.

The upper black-blue region should retain subtle texture instead of becoming a perfectly smooth digital gradient.

Do not add a moon.

Do not add realistic mountains.

Do not add architecture.

Do not add dense stars.

MAIN WHITE SPIRIT MARTEN

Create one gigantic supernatural white marten as the primary subject.

It must read as a stylized mustelid:
marten,
sable,
ferret-like mythical animal.

Do not interpret it as:
bear,
dog,
wolf,
fox,
cat,
rabbit,
human,
deer.

ANATOMY

Use a very long flexible mustelid torso.

The body is vertically elongated because it has risen onto the hind legs.

Use:

small pointed head,
short neck,
narrow sloping shoulders,
very long torso,
slightly curved spine,
shorter forelimbs,
strong hindquarters,
long tail.

The body must remain animal-like even though it stands upright.

Do not give it human hips or human chest anatomy.

POSE

The white marten stands on its two hind legs.

It faces viewer-left in a slight three-quarter profile.

Its pelvis remains low and slightly behind the ribcage.

The upper body bends forward toward the smaller animal.

The shoulders are rounded and hunched.

The head is lowered.

The muzzle points diagonally down-left.

The pose should communicate:
caution,
authority,
curiosity,
mild hostility,
supernatural stillness.

Do not make it heroic.

Do not make it stand perfectly straight like a human.

The spine must retain a noticeable animal curve.

HEAD

Use a compact wedge-shaped mustelid head.

Features:

short triangular ears,
small narrow forehead,
slender pointed muzzle,
small coral-pink nose,
narrow red-orange eye,
simple sharp cheek line.

Expression:
focused,
slightly suspicious,
quietly threatening.

Do not use round cute cartoon eyes.

Do not create a broad canine muzzle.

FOREHEAD ORNAMENT

Place one extremely distinctive golden-orange ritual horn or flame-shaped ornament on the forehead.

The ornament begins near the brow and rises diagonally upward.

Its base is orange-red.

Its long upper point is golden yellow.

The form should resemble:
a ceremonial flame,
a stylized single horn,
a ritual blade.

It is decorative rather than biological.

Do not add a pair of horns.

Do not turn the creature into a unicorn.

NECK COLLAR

Around the neck place one thin smooth golden collar.

Use:
warm yellow-gold,
small orange shading.

Keep it simple and circular.

FORELIMBS

Both forelegs hang in front of the torso.

The arm nearer viewer-left descends lower.

The opposite forearm bends slightly.

Use clear animal paws rather than human hands.

The paws may have slightly elongated simplified digits, but they should remain graphic and animal-like.

Keep the elbows bent and relaxed.

Do not make the arms symmetrical.

HIND LEGS

The white creature stands fully on both hind legs.

One hind foot is placed toward viewer-left.

The other remains farther viewer-right.

This creates a slightly wide stable stance.

Both knees bend minimally.

Feet are broad, flat and simplified.

Use:
ivory,
cream,
pale peach shadow.

Do not create human feet.

Do not add claws as realistic detail.

WHITE MARTEN COLOR SYSTEM

Main body:
warm ivory,
cream white,
very pale peach.

Shadow planes:
salmon pink,
dusty coral,
muted rose.

Use one broad coral shadow region running along the viewer-right side of:
neck,
shoulder,
back,
torso,
hind limb.

Keep the transitions geometric.

Do not shade with fur.

Do not add individual hairs.

TAIL

The tail is extremely important.

Use one very long pale ivory tail.

It begins at the rump.

It drops diagonally downward.

It reaches the ground near lower-right.

It then sweeps in a huge curve across the bottom foreground toward viewer-left.

The tail forms a large open loop.

The tip curves gently inward.

The tail should remain approximately the same thickness for much of its length and taper gradually near the end.

Use a coral-red shadow strip along one side.

Do not shorten the tail.

Do not hide the tail behind the body.

Do not raise the tail upward.

It must become a major lower compositional curve.

SECONDARY PURPLE SPIRIT MARTEN

At lower-left create one smaller supernatural marten.

Unlike the white creature, this one remains fully quadrupedal.

It stands on all four legs.

BODY

Use:
slim mustelid torso,
narrow waist,
raised shoulder line,
slightly arched back,
long legs,
long curling tail.

Its proportions may be somewhat feline, but the body should still feel slender and mustelid-like.

POSE

The smaller creature stands diagonally.

Its body travels from lower-left toward center.

Its head turns strongly upward-right toward the large white marten.

Its neck stretches slightly upward.

Its mouth is slightly open.

The posture should feel startled or challenging.

Both front feet remain planted.

Both rear feet remain planted.

Do not make it sit.

Do not make it jump.

TAIL

The purple tail is long and highly graphic.

It rises almost vertically behind the body on viewer-left.

Then it bends into one large smooth hook.

The tail tip points inward.

Keep it clearly visible against the dark background.

COLOR

Main body:
medium violet,
royal purple.

Shadow:
deep indigo,
blue-violet.

Highlights:
lavender,
small pale cyan accents.

Use flat geometric surfaces.

No realistic fur.

FACE

Give the creature:
small pointed ears,
compact triangular face,
light-colored eye,
short muzzle,
small open mouth.

The gaze should clearly land on the large white creature.

DIVINE LAMP INSTALLATION

Behind the creatures create one enormous branching ritual lamp structure.

It should resemble a fusion of:
ancient lamp tree,
ritual candelabrum,
ceremonial bronze tree,
botanical branching diagram.

CENTRAL TRUNK

Use a narrow cobalt-blue and violet vertical central column.

The trunk rises from the lower-middle area to the upper-middle.

Add subtle warm gold ornamental lines along selected areas.

From this central shaft, branch many thin curved blue stems.

The branches travel:
left,
right,
upward,
and downward.

Keep their layout controlled.

Do not create random tangled lines.

RITUAL BOWLS

Attach approximately 9–12 shallow ritual lamp bowls across the branching network.

Vary their heights.

Each bowl is:
shallow,
elliptical,
slightly upward-facing.

Use:

jade-green rim,
mint-green body,
coral-red ornamental band,
warm golden outline,
pale cream interior.

Decorate the outer bowl surfaces with simplified symmetrical floral or cloud-scroll motifs in coral red and gold.

The bowls should feel inspired by ancient Chinese ritual vessels but highly graphic.

Do not use realistic bronze texture.

Arrange them in a cascading vertical hierarchy.

The largest bowl may sit near upper-center.

Medium bowls surround the middle.

Smaller bowls descend toward the lower branches.

BLUE SUPPORT STEMS

Each bowl rests on a narrow blue stem.

Use:
cobalt,
royal blue,
violet.

Some stems connect back into the main central column.

Others curve outward before returning.

Use smooth controlled arcs.

BIRD / PHOENIX FINIALS

At approximately four outer branch tips, place stylized bird-shaped ceremonial finials.

Their bodies resemble simplified phoenixes or divine birds.

Each bird consists of:

golden-orange torso,
small pale yellow head,
green wing or tail structure,
three small yellow crest shapes,
blue-violet lotus-like pedestal underneath.

Keep each bird facing inward or slightly toward the central structure.

The tallest bird finial sits near upper-right.

Another sits upper-left.

Two more sit mid-right and lower-left.

Use the birds as repeating symbolic anchors.

Do not make them realistic birds.

CENTRAL FLAME

Above the largest upper-central bowl, place one large floating dark supernatural flame.

Use:
deep burgundy,
black-red,
dark violet,
thin coral-red edge.

The flame points upward and diagonally.

Construct it from elongated smooth graphic curls.

It should appear like a dark spiritual fire rather than normal orange flame.

OTHER DARK FLAMES

Scatter several additional smaller dark red-black flame forms around the lamp branches.

Place some:
mid-left,
middle-right,
lower-center.

Keep them visually connected to the ritual installation.

Do not overcrowd the scene.

Do not turn them into smoke explosions.

WHITE SPIRIT PARTICLES

Scatter a small quantity of tiny white speckles around the lamp bowls and dark flames.

The particles may read as:
ash,
spiritual dust,
tiny stars.

Keep them sparse.

No large glowing orbs.

SMOKE RIBBONS

Create several thin pale cyan or gray-white smoke ribbons.

Use smooth horizontal S-curves.

One may float across mid-right behind the white creature.

Another may cross lower-left behind the purple creature.

Keep smoke extremely flat and graphic.

No realistic volumetric smoke.

ABSTRACT LOWER ROCK / FLAME BASE

Behind the lower lamp installation and between the creatures, create layered supernatural forms.

Use:
deep navy,
royal purple,
indigo,
electric blue,
violet,
small cyan edges.

These forms may resemble:
dark rocks,
ritual fire,
cut-paper clouds,
mineral formations.

Use sharp irregular silhouettes.

Add a few internal angular holes.

Do not use realistic rock texture.

GROUND

Create one narrow horizontal dark-blue ground platform beneath both animals.

Use:
deep navy,
purple-blue.

Extend it slightly toward viewer-right.

Add a few thinner horizontal blue strips toward viewer-left.

This ground is graphic rather than realistic.

RED ANNOTATION LABELS

Place several narrow red Chinese annotation seals throughout the image.

Positions may include:

beside upper central lamp,
viewer-left bird finial,
beside white marten,
beside purple marten,
lower lamp structure.

Use:
thin vermilion rectangular borders,
vertical Chinese characters,
small square red seals.

Keep them sparse.

They should resemble cultural specimen labels or mythical catalog annotations.

Do not make them large titles.

BOTTOM EDITORIAL TYPOGRAPHY

Along the very bottom margin place tiny editorial credits.

Viewer-left:
small uppercase English text.

Center:
small title such as “SPIRIT MARTEN & DIVINE LAMP”.

Viewer-right:
small cultural illustration credit.

Use dark violet-blue typography.

Keep all text extremely small and subordinate.

COMPOSITIONAL HIERARCHY

Upper area:
vast dark negative space.

Upper-middle:
phoenix finials and highest ritual bowls.

Center:
main lamp tree.

Center-right:
large white upright spirit marten.

Lower-left:
small purple quadruped spirit marten.

Bottom:
giant pale tail loop + narrow ground platform.

The contrast between the enormous white marten and smaller purple creature is essential.

The lamp installation creates a vertical axis between them.

The white tail creates a broad lower compositional arc.

STYLE

T1 flat 2D contemporary Chinese editorial illustration.

New-Chinese supernatural cultural poster.

Geometric animal anatomy.

Highly controlled stylized silhouettes.

Clean vector-like edge precision.

Flat color blocking.

Minimal outlines.

Limited restrained gradients.

Graphic ritual-object construction.

Elegant strange-tale atmosphere.

Selective Art-Deco-like structural organization.

Vintage lithographic texture.

Subtle silkscreen grain.

Matte handmade-paper finish.

The image should feel designed and printed, not digitally painted.

COLOR SYSTEM

background:
black-blue,
midnight navy,
indigo,
cobalt,
pale cyan.

white marten:
ivory,
cream,
peach,
coral-pink shadow.

purple marten:
violet,
purple,
indigo,
lavender.

lamp stems:
cobalt,
royal blue,
violet.

ritual bowls:
jade,
mint,
coral,
gold.

bird finials:
orange,
yellow,
green,
blue-violet.

spiritual flames:
burgundy,
black-red,
deep violet.

annotations:
seal red.

LIGHTING ARCHITECTURE

Treat lighting as graphic color separation.

The environment is overwhelmingly dark.

Use very low-intensity cool blue ambient fill.

The white spirit marten becomes the largest bright mass.

Its viewer-left and upper-facing body planes remain warm ivory.

Its viewer-right planes shift toward pale coral and pink.

The purple marten stays darker, using violet midtones and indigo shadows.

The divine lamp colors remain saturated but do not act as realistic light sources.

No broad golden illumination.

No realistic cast-shadow physics.

No dramatic rim light.

No cinematic backlight.

No volumetric fog.

No large bloom.

Keep dark background values deep and continuous.

MOOD

mysterious,
ritualistic,
quiet,
strange,
slightly confrontational,
mythological,
elegant,
nocturnal,
poetic rather than frightening.

STRICT WHITE MARTEN STRUCTURE LOCK

The large white creature is an upright supernatural marten.

Preserve:

small pointed mustelid head,
short neck,
long flexible torso,
rounded hunched shoulders,
bipedal hind-leg stance,
two hanging forelegs,
animal paws,
extremely long ground-sweeping tail.

Do not create human anatomy.

Do not make the torso muscular.

Do not create bear anatomy.

Do not create canine anatomy.

Do not create a fox with fluffy tail.

Do not create rabbit anatomy.

STRICT WHITE MARTEN POSE LOCK

The white marten stands only on its two hind legs.

Torso bends toward viewer-left.

Head lowers toward the smaller purple creature.

Both forelegs hang downward.

Both hind feet remain planted.

Tail lies on the ground.

Do not place the white creature on all fours.

Do not make it sit.

Do not make it run.

Do not raise its arms heroically.

STRICT PURPLE MARTEN POSE LOCK

The purple creature remains on all four legs.

Head lifts upward toward the white marten.

Back slightly arched.

Tail rises vertically and curves.

All four paws remain on the ground.

Do not make it upright.

Do not make it human-like.

STRICT STYLE FIDELITY LOCK

Preserve:
deep navy-black upper negative space,
pale cyan lower fade,
large upright ivory marten on the right,
small violet quadruped marten on the left,
central multi-tier divine lamp tree,
jade-red shallow ritual bowls,
orange-green bird finials,
dark burgundy spiritual flames,
pale smoke ribbons,
giant curved white tail,
red seal labels,
matte paper texture.

Do not convert to photorealism.

Do not create realistic fur.

Do not add individual hair strands.

Do not use glossy 3D CGI.

Do not use game splash-art rendering.

Do not create realistic metal lamps.

Do not create realistic fire.

Do not create realistic smoke.

Do not use thick black comic outlines.

Do not add dense environmental scenery.
